turns.text: Hello. Staff already closed my damage claim and told me the pale patches belong in the drawing. I reject that decision.
I’ve passed your complaint to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision about the pale patches.

input.summary: Customer disputes a prior damage claim decision. They say staff closed the claim after explaining that the pale patches were part of the drawing. Please review the prior decision with the customer. No order number or email provided.
